import trimesh, numpy as np
base = trimesh.load('exports/model.base.87e59dfb.stl')
lid = trimesh.load('exports/model.lid.6029fe16.stl')
pin = trimesh.load('exports/model.pin.a1529210.stl')
# sample: use vertices + AABB tree approximations via scipy?
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
for name,(A,B) in {"base-pin":(base,pin),"base-lid":(base,lid)}.items():
    tA = cKDTree(np.asarray(A.vertices)); tB = np.asarray(B.vertices)
    d,_ = tB.query(tA.data, k=1) if False else (None,None)
    # vertex to vertex both ways approx
    d1,_ = cKDTree(tB).query(np.asarray(A.vertices),k=1)
    d2,_ = cKDTree(np.asarray(A.vertices)).query(np.asarray(B.vertices),k=1)
    i1 = np.argmin(d1); i2=np.argmin(d2)
    print(name, "min v-v", d1.min(), np.asarray(A.vertices)[i1], " | ", d2.min(), np.asarray(B.vertices)[i2])
